Māṭharasya vanam : nt.: Name of a forest.

Situated on the Varuṇasrotas mountain in the south (3. 86. 1); described as holy, auspicious and having many roots and fruits (puṇyaṁ bahumūlaphalaṁ śivam) 3. 86. 7.
